entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. Order number is 772-B-910.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Pulling up your order now... I see it's for the Apex cycling shoes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work for me. They gave me blisters on a long ride, and I can't seem to get the cleats adjusted right. I just want a refund. Can I get one or not?
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... Okay, I see they were delivered 34 days ago.

No problem at all. Those specific cycling shoes fall under our 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that window, I can process this return for a full refund immediately. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email on file right now.
Okay, fine. I'll look for the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
